jobs.title: SAP Supply Chain Lead
jobs.content: <p>Brassworks Valve Co. makes industrial valves in two Connecticut plants.</p><h3>The role</h3><p>Own SAP MM, PP and EWM for both plants and lead our ECC 6.0 to S/4HANA conversion with an implementation partner. Hybrid, 3 days in New Haven.</p><p>Salary range: $145,000–$170,000.</p>
